Sign up for the Breaking News US email In Maine, Troy Jackson , the Democratic nominee for US Senate, and Susan Collins , the five-term Republican incumbent traded barbs on Thursday in their final debate ahead of the November midterms. This was the fourth showdown between the pair. Collins has tried to cast Jackson as an inexperienced state lawmaker, and attempted to yoke him to the former nominee, Graham Platner , who dropped out of the race earlier this year following allegations of rape and sexual assault (which he still denies).
